decisions.rationale: One row per scheduled flight departure: year, month, day, sched_dep_time, carrier, flight, and origin together identify a single scheduled departure; all seven columns have null_rate 0.0 and are proposed required, and the combination should be unique against 166158 rows (to be measured at review).

dep_time and dep_delay are null for 4883 rows (null_rate 0.029388) and arr_time/arr_delay/air_time for up to 5480 rows (null_rate 0.032981), consistent with cancelled or diverted flights; rows are retained with nulls and an is_cancelled flag is derived from null dep_time.
All numeric columns landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every profiled sample and distinct value is integral (e.g. month 1.0-6.0, distance 80.0-4983.0), so they are cast to INTEGER.

tailnum has null_rate 0.009154 (1521 nulls); missing registrations are retained as null rather than imputed or dropped.

purpose: silver_nyc_flights is the cleaned, typed record of 2013 NYC flight departures (January through June) from the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), one row per scheduled flight departure. It feeds on-time performance analysis, carrier comparisons, and route-level reporting downstream of bronze.nyc_flights.
usage: Read one row per scheduled departure keyed by year, month, day, sched_dep_time, carrier, flight, and origin. Consumers measuring actual performance must deliberately filter is_cancelled = false (or exclude null dep_time/arr_delay rows), since roughly 2.9-3.3% of rows represent flights that never departed or lack arrival data. Delay columns are in minutes; dep_time/arr_time columns are HHMM-encoded integers; use time_hour for timestamp-based joins and aggregation.
limitations: Covers only 2013 months 1-6 from the single profiled load (166158 rows). Nulls are retained, not resolved: dep_time and dep_delay are null at rate 0.029388, arr_time at 0.0307, arr_delay and air_time at 0.032981, and tailnum at 0.009154. HHMM-encoded time integers are cast but not converted to true TIME values, and the declared grain has not yet been measured against the warehouse.
